# CodexStation IEF

Canonical public source for the CodexStation Isolated Execution Fabric.

Primary documents:
- README.md — project overview and invariants
- ARCHITECTURE.md — execution architecture and assurance classes
- GOVERNANCE.md — public/private promotion doctrine
- SECURITY.md — security invariants
- ROADMAP.md — specification progression
- specs/CS-IEF-02.md — execution specification/receipt contract
- specs/CS-IEF-03.md — provider ABI and capability negotiation
- specs/CS-IEF-04.md — MicrosandboxProvider reference mapping and qualification gates
- providers/microsandbox/README.md — reference adapter boundary and status
- sources/microsandbox.yaml — pinned reference-provider source manifest

Current verified Microsandbox source snapshot:
- e36792dae06edcd9b6f86abd6b83da7a26c7cdf6

Key rules:
- Microsandbox is a reference provider behind the stable IEF ABI, not the architectural core.
- Feature support is not assurance evidence.
- No EAC-3 assignment exists until active-environment qualification passes.
- Provider-specific types must remain below the stable IEF kernel boundary.
